privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Alles In 1 Winkel respects your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, what we use it for, and what rights you have. Questions? Email mijnwinkel.vercel@proton.me.

sections.p: Alles In 1 Winkel is a trading name for an online store selling smart gadgets and handy products. You can reach us at mijnwinkel.vercel@proton.me.

When you place an order we process: your name, address, email address, phone number, the products ordered and the amount paid. We do not process payment details such as card numbers ourselves; our payment partner Stripe does that.

sections.h: What we use your data for
sections.p: We only use your data to: process and deliver your order, handle payments, keep you informed about your order status, and answer your questions. We never sell your data to third parties.

sections.h: How long we keep your data
sections.p: We keep order data as long as needed to fulfil the agreement and comply with legal retention obligations, in any case no longer than 2 years after your last order.

We only share your data with parties needed for your order: Stripe (payments), Vercel (website hosting) and carriers (delivery of your package). These parties may not use your data for other purposes.
Our website only uses technically necessary cookies, for example to keep track of your cart. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.
Your data is transmitted encrypted (SSL) and is only accessible to people who need it for their work. Payments go through Stripe’s secure environment.

You have the right to access, correct, delete and transfer your data, and you can object to processing. Send an email to mijnwinkel.vercel@proton.me. We respond within 30 days. You also have the right to file a complaint with your local data protection authority.
This policy may change. The latest version is always on this page.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These terms apply to all orders at Alles In 1 Winkel. By placing an order you agree to these terms. Questions? Email mijnwinkel.vercel@proton.me.

sections.p: Alles In 1 Winkel is a trading name for an online store selling smart gadgets and handy products, reachable at mijnwinkel.vercel@proton.me.
An order is only final once you have completed the order and payment has been received. After payment you receive a confirmation by email. The agreement is formed at the moment of that confirmation.
All prices are in euros. Payment runs securely through Stripe with iDEAL or credit card. Your order is only processed after successful payment.
Order today, delivered tomorrow. If a product is sold out, we reorder it urgently and it will still be shipped as soon as possible. Delivery times may differ in exceptional cases.

You have the right to withdraw your order within 14 days of receipt without giving a reason. Email us within that period at mijnwinkel.vercel@proton.me. You will receive the purchase amount back within 14 days of your message.
Our warranty applies to all products: not satisfied? Money back within 7 days. See the guarantee page for the full conditions.
We do our best to deliver your order correctly. We are not liable for damage resulting from misuse of a product or force majeure.
Not happy with our service? Email mijnwinkel.vercel@proton.me and we will sort it out. We aim to respond within 2 working days.
Dutch law applies to these terms. Your statutory rights as a consumer in your own country always remain applicable.

about.title: About us
about.p1: Alles In 1 Winkel is an online store with smart gadgets and useful products for everyday life. We select products that make life just a little easier — from smart solutions for the home to handy accessories on the go.
about.p2: We work directly with manufacturers and suppliers, so we can offer competitive prices without sacrificing quality. Every order is carefully prepared and shipped.
about.p3: Our goal is simple: make customers happy with good products, fast delivery and honest service. No complicated conditions, no surprises — just clear and reliable.
about.promise1: Competitive prices through direct collaboration with suppliers
about.promise2: Secure payment via Stripe (iDEAL, credit card)
